fusions.name: Grip and Wrench
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and wrench its armour apart, dealing 14 damage. It is left [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 14% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Chest-Drum Clatter
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health and deals 8 resonating damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 35% chance to leave each [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Barbed Return
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 6 health.

fusions.name: Rattled Temper
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (36% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour is 5% higher at all times.
